repo.description:
### Impact

Staff invite acceptance allowed the user to specify any email address when creating their account. This could allow a leaked invite token to be accepted with an attacker-controlled email. The legitimate invite recipient could also use an email provider other than the one intended by the site administrator.

### Vulnerable versions

This vulnerability is present in Ghost from v0.5.0 up to v6.62.0

### Patches

v6.62.0 contains a fix for this issue.

### How to update

For self-hosters using Docker, find [Docker's official Ghost image here](https://hub.docker.com/_/ghost). Updating a Docker-based Ghost instance [is documented here](https://docs.ghost.org/install/docker#updating-ghost). 

If your Ghost is a Ghost-CLI install see our documentation on [updating it to the latest version here](https://docs.ghost.org/update). 

### References

We thank [Himanshu Anand](https://github.com/unknownhad) ([@anand_himanshu](https://twitter.com/anand_himanshu)), [doanmanhducz](https://github.com/doanmanhducz), Pedro Pinho, and [EclipsSec](https://github.com/EclipsSec) for disclosing this vulnerability responsibly.

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory, email us at [security@ghost.org](mailto:security@ghost.org).
repo.summary: Staff Could Accept Invite with any Email
